svg.title: Elasticsearch & OpenSearch
svg.desc: Elasticsearch & OpenSearch. Search engines built on inverted indexes: full-text queries ranked by relevance, and aggregations over sharded indexes. Step 1, Where it sits: Acme Shop writes to PostgreSQL; CDC through Kafka feeds the products index; searches go there. Step 2, Analyse, index, refresh: Red ceramic mug is analysed into red, ceram, mug; a refresh 1 s later makes it searchable in P1. Step 3, Route, replicate, search: _id 14 routes to P1, which copies it to R1. node-1 asks one copy of each shard, merges, fetches 3. Step 4, Failover and the limits: node-2 fails: R1 becomes primary, health turns yellow. Limits: a copy, mappings, paging, shards.

g.text: Acme Shop writes to PostgreSQL; CDC through Kafka feeds the products index; searches go there.
Red ceramic mug is analysed into red, ceram, mug; a refresh 1 s later makes it searchable in P1.
_id 14 routes to P1, which copies it to R1. node-1 asks one copy of each shard, merges, fetches 3.
node-2 fails: R1 becomes primary, health turns yellow. Limits: a copy, mappings, paging, shards.
a search copy of the catalogue in PostgreSQL
3 primary shards P0–P2, 1 replica each R0–R2;
a replica never sits on its primary’s node
CDC keeps it in step; refresh_interval 1s
full text: red mug in title or description,
facets: how many hits per brand
the same engine stores logs in data streams
(logs-acme); ILM, or ISM in OpenSearch, rolls
them over and deletes old ones, and Kibana or
OpenSearch Dashboards searches and charts them
counts cover all 5 hits, not just 3
stems need not be words: ceramic → ceram
the shard count is fixed when the
index is created; replicas and the
query phase: one copy of every shard
P1 indexes _id 14, then copies it to R1
R1 has _id 14 too: an in-sync copy
filter: yes or no, no score; often-
size 3: each shard sends its own
the master on node-1 promotes R1 on node-3 to
primary and publishes the new cluster state;
searches and writes go on. Health is yellow until
R0 and R1 are rebuilt, which waits 1 min by default
a copy, not the system of record
it lags by the refresh; no multi-document transactions
every new field name grows the mapping: limit 1000
from + size stops at 10,000: page with search_after
plan it: Elastic suggests 10–50 GB per shard
R0 and R1 wait 1 min in case
node-2 comes back, then R0 is
rebuilt on node-3 and R1 on node-1;
health is green again after that
